featuredStrategy: Streaming-style row: one entry point per series (ep 1 or lead trailer). Characters (Mozvane + daBeezy) share one series for Series up-next. Shorts are a separate bottom rail and never enter the modal pool. Featured row max 6 — swap titles rather than grow the rail. Characters + Crossovers sort newest-first (releasedAt, then sortOrder).
